rationale: Class 3 aggregate coverage flag: the raw SOI uses separate numeric leaves for principal/shares, amortized cost, fair value, and percent of net assets. The current-period investment rows therefore naturally have only one fair-value leaf among multiple numeric leaves, while the SOI fair-value total is present and matches the observed fair-value anchor at 164,829,686. The 145/290 fair-value-leaf ratio is a denominator/rule-scope artifact, not evidence that fair values are missing from the holdings.
